briefing.headline: AN jumps 12.1% overnight as the only big gainer among major tokens
briefing.summary: Mega‑cap tech stocks were split, with Amazon up over 5% while Microsoft and Apple slipped 3% and 2% respectively. The broader market index SPY fell about 1.4%, matching the mixed direction of the core group. Leveraged semiconductor ETFs like SOXL and related small‑cap tokens plunged 20%‑22%, pulling down overall breadth. Overall, advancers and decliners were evenly matched, indicating a neutral to mixed tone heading into the US open.

macro_context.title: Fed policy unchanged
macro_context.detail: No change to the Federal Funds target range was reported, and the yield curve remains non‑inverted.
